info.title: Engage API
info.description: This spec contains details about the Telesign Engage API.

post.description:
Send an SMS message. Use request parameters to specify the type of message, what phase of the account lifecycle the message is being sent in, and additional details about the transaction.

## General requirements
* **Authentication:** [Basic](/enterprise/docs/authentication#basic-authentication) (easiest to implement) or [Digest](/enterprise/docs/authentication#digest-authentication)
* **Encoding:** Accepts only **UTF-8 unicode** characters as inputs.
* **Accepts:** `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`
* **Required headers:** `Content-Type - application/x-www-form-urlencoded`
* **Rate limit:** [Default rate limits by product](https://support.telesign.com/s/article/do-you-have-any-rate-limits)

phone_number.description: The end user's phone number with country code included. Avoid use of special characters and spaces.

message.description: Text of the message to be sent to the end user. You are limited to 1600 characters. If you send a very long message, Telesign splits your message into separate parts. Telesign recommends against sending messages that require multiple SMSes when possible.

message_type.description:
This parameter specifies the traffic type being sent in the message. You can provide one of the following values -
* OTP (One time passwords)
* ARN (Alerts, reminders, and notifications)
* MKT (Marketing traffic)

account_lifecycle_event.description:
This parameter allows you to indicate what phase of the lifecycle you are in when you send a transaction. The options for this parameter are - 
* create - For the creation of a new account)
* sign-in For when an end user signs in to their account.
* transact - For when an end user completes a transaction within their account
* update - For when an update is performed, such as an update of account information or similar. 
* delete - For when an account is deleted.

sender_id.description: This parameter allows you to set a specific sender ID to be used on an SMS message sent to the end user. In order to use a specific sender ID, Telesign must whitelist your selected sender ID values. Be aware that 100% preservation of a sender ID value is not guaranteed. Telesign may override the sender ID value that your end user will receive in order to improve delivery quality or follow SMS regulations in particular countries. In order to use this feature, you must contact Telesign Support and have them enable it for you. We recommend limiting values to 0-9 and A-Z, as support for other ASCII characters varies by carrier.

external_id.description: A customer-generated ID for this transaction. The response simply echoes the value provided for this parameter.

originating_ip.description: Your end user's IP address (do not send your own IP address). This is used to help Telesign improve our services. IPv4 and IPv6 are supported. For IPv4, the value must be in the format defined by the Internet Engineering Task Force (IETF) in the Internet-Draft document titled [Internet Protocol](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc791). For IPv6, the value must be in the format defined by the IETF in the Internet-Draft document titled [IP Version 6 Addressing Architecture](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc4291#section-2.2).

callback_url.description: A URL where you want delivery reports to be sent related to your request. This overrides any default callback URL that you’ve previously set. The override only lasts for this request.

is_primary.description: Whether you are using this service as your primary provider to send this message (`”true”`) or as a backup after your primary provider failed (`”false”`). We use this data to optimize message routing.

dlt_template_id.description: **(India-local traffic only)**. The ID of the DLT template used for this message. See *[India DLT Update](https://support.telesign.com/s/article/India-DLT-Update)* for more details on the relevant regulations.

dlt_entity_id.description: **(India-local traffic only)**. The ID of the entity sending this message. See *[India DLT Update](https://support.telesign.com/s/article/India-DLT-Update)* for more details on the relevant regulations.

post.description:
Use this endpoint to send the same SMS message to multiple recipients.

## General requirements
* **Authentication:** [Basic](/enterprise/docs/authentication#basic-authentication) (easiest to implement) or [Digest](/enterprise/docs/authentication#digest-authentication)
* **Encoding:** Accepts only **UTF-8 unicode** characters as inputs.
* **Accepts:** `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`
* **Responds with:** `application/json`
* **Required headers:** `Content-Type - application/x-www-form-urlencoded`
* **Rate limit:** [Default rate limits by product](https://support.telesign.com/s/article/do-you-have-any-rate-limits)

recipients.description: Comma separated list of recipient phone numbers (maximum of 1000). Optionally append a session ID to each phone number separated by a colon.

template.description: The text of the message to your recipients.

ucid.description:
A string specifying a use case code. Choices include -
* ATCK - for use in a 2FA situation like updating an account or logging in
* BACF - for creating an account where the service may be vulnerable to bulk attacks and fraudsters
* BACS - for creating an account where the service may be vulnerable to bulk attacks or individual spammers
* CHBK - for use when someone is trying to buy something expensive or unusual and you want to verify it is really them
* CLDR - calendar event
* LEAD - for use in a situation where you require a person to enter personal information in order to obtain information about something like a loan or realty or school, and you want to check if the person is bogus or not
* OTHR - if you have a situation not addressed by other tags
* PWRT - for use in a situation where a password reset is required
* RESV - for use when you have end users making reservations and not showing up, and you want to be able to include phone verification in the loop
* RXPF - for use when you are trying to prevent prescription fraud
* SHIP - for use when you are sending a shipping notification
* THEF - for use when you are trying to prevent an end user from deactivating or redirecting a phone number in order to take over someone else's identity
* TRVF - for use when you are transferring money and you want to check to see if it is approved by sending a text message or phone call to your end user. This is similar to CHBK, but is specifically for a money transaction
* UNKN - if you have a situation not addressed by other tags (same as OTHR)

post.description:
Use this action to send a message with advanced features through your specified channel (optionally with cascading backup channels) to a recipient phone number or email address. 

To add this product to your account, [contact a Telesign expert](https://www.telesign.com/contact-sales?utm_campaign=contact%20sales%20form&utm_source=developer_portal&utm_medium=Referrer&utm_content=messaging). This product is available for full-service accounts only.


## General requirements
* **Authentication:** [Basic](/enterprise/docs/authentication#basic-authentication) (easiest to implement) or [Digest](/enterprise/docs/authentication#digest-authentication)
* **Encoding:** Accepts only **UTF-8 unicode** characters as inputs.
* **Accepts:** `application/json`
* **Responds with:** `application/json`
* **Rate limit:** [Default rate limits by product](https://support.telesign.com/s/article/do-you-have-any-rate-limits)

channels.description: All the potential channels you want the service to be able to try and details on how to use those channels. If the first channel attempted fails, you have specified a fallback channel, and the fallback timeout has elapsed, the service looks to the next channel object here for details on what to do.

message.description: Contains properties specifying to the service how to construct the message for each channel. There should be one object in here for each channel, plus a default object with configuration to be applied if none of the specified channels can be used.

message_type.description: The purpose for which the message is being sent. Choose from `OTP` - one-time passwords, `ARN` - alerts, reminders, and notifications, or `MKT` - marketing messages.

external_id.description: Your own identifier, used to refer to this transaction.

callback_url.description: Your URL that you want Telesign to send callbacks to for this transaction. Overrides any previously set callback URL for your account.

account_lifecycle_event.description:
The phase of the customer life-cycle the end user is in when this transaction is sent. Choices include: 
* `create` - Create a new account. 
* `sign-in` - End user signs-in to their account. 
* `transact` - End user completes a transaction. 
* `update` - End user updates contact details or other info related to their account. 
* `delete` - Delete an account.

sender_id.description: Specifies the  [sender ID](https://support.telesign.com/s/article/What-is-a-Sender-ID) to be displayed to the end user on the generated message. Before using this, give any sender IDs you might want to use to our Customer Support Team, so we can add them to our allow list. If the sender ID in this field is not on this list, it is not used. template.description: The name of the template to use for this message.

parameters.description: Contains sub-properties with values for variables in the message template. Which sub-properties to include here depends on which template you have selected.

url.description:
The source URL for a media file to embed in the message.
**Required for:** `image`, `video`, `audio`

OmniReqDetailsForViber.title: OmniReqDetailsForViber
OmniReqDetailsForViber.description: Contains properties specifying to the service how to construct the message for this channel.

template.description: The name of the template to use for this message.

parameters.description: Contains sub-properties with values for variables in the message template. Which sub-properties to include here depends on which template you have selected.

text.description:
The main text of your message.
**Required for:** `text`, `text_session`, `url_action`, `text_video` and `url_action_video`.

url.description:
Depending on the template being used, this is the URL for the link in the message or the URL where you are hosting an image or video file in the message.
**Required for:** `image`, `image_session`, `url_action`, `video`, `text_video`, and `url_action_video`.

url_id.description: Unique identifier for the link in the message. **Required for:** `url_action`

url_text.example: Learn more about our deals here.
url_text.description:
Text for the link button in the message.
**Required for:** `url_action`

open_url.description: The URL end users are directed to or the action performed when pressing the action button.

url_thumbnail.description:
A static image that acts as the preview image for the video.
**Required for:** `text_video`.

otp_code.description:
The OTP code of your verified template message.
**Required for:** `otp_verify`

language.description:
ISO 639-1 two-letter language code. For more details, see [Messaging - Send Viber verification message](/enterprise/docs/messaging-send-viber-verification-message). If not specified, the default value will be English language.
**Optional for:** `otp_verify`

reply_id.description: This is sent back to the provider when a message sent to a end user is answered. The end user’s reply is linked to the tracking data value that is set in the request.

button_text.description: The text that appears on the action button.

OmniReqDetailsForEmail.title: OmniReqDetailsForEmail
OmniReqDetailsForEmail.description: Contains properties specifying to the service how to construct the message for this channel.

template.description: The name of the custom template to use for this message.

parameters.description: Contains sub-properties with values for variables in the message template. Which sub-properties to include here depends on what is defined in your custom template.

OmniReqRecipient.title: OmniReqRecipient
OmniReqRecipient.description: Contains properties specifying the contact information needed to communicate with a recipient for a particular channel. At least one sub-property must be included. If the `phone_number` parameter is not included in this request, this parameter is required.

phone_number.description: The recipient's phone number, as digits without spaces or special characters, beginning with the country dialing code. **Required if RCS, SMS, WA, Viber, or MMS is selected as the channel.**

email.description: The recipient's email address. **Required if email is selected as the channel.**

reference_id.description: The service's unique identifier for this transaction.

sub_resource.description: The Telesign service you made this request to.

errors.description: Each object in this array describes an error that occurred during the processing of this request.

BulkSMSStatus.title: BulkSMSStatus
BulkSMSStatus.description: Contains properties related to the processing status of the transaction.

code.description: One of the status codes or error codes.

updated_on.description: An [RFC 3339](http://www.ietf.org/rfc/rfc3339.txt) timestamp indicating when the transaction status was updated.

code.description: A 1 to 5-digit error code (possibly negative) that indicates the type of error that occurred.

description.description: Text describing the error that occurred.

reference_id.description: A 32-digit hex value used to identify the web service request. The value is unique to each web service request, is randomly generated by Telesign, and is returned in the response message immediately following the web service request.

subresource.description: The subresource in the URI path from your original request to initiate this transaction. Indicates which form of verification you used.

errors.description: Contains an object for each error that resulted from the request.

code.description: A numeric code describing the processing status of your transaction. See [All status and error codes](/enterprise/docs/all-status-and-error-codes)

description.description: A text description of the status code.

updated_on.description: This is a timestamp showing when your transaction status was updated last.

phone_number_modified.description:
Indicates whether the end user's phone number provided in the request was modified before processing by Telesign to increase message deliverability.
Contact our [Customer Support Team](mailto:support@telesign.com) to enable this feature. Possible values are `"True"` and `"False"`.

external_id.description: The customer-generated ID for this transaction that was provided in the request. If the `external_id` parameter was not included in the request, the value here is `null`.

cleansed_phone_number.description: The corrected version of the submitted phone number returned in the response after common formatting issues are fixed to improve deliverability. If there are no changes, the original phone number from the request is returned. Contact our [Customer Support Team](support@telesign.com) to enable this feature.

additionalInfo.title: additionalInfo
additionalInfo.description: Contains properties relevant when the message sent with this transaction is one of several parts of a longer message that was split. Only appears if message-splitting is enabled for your account. Contact our [Customer Support Team](mailto:support@telesign.com) to request this feature.

message_part_sequence_number.description: Indicates this message's position in the series of split parts.

message_parts_count.description: The total number of split parts for the longer message. If the message is not split, this value is `1`.

message_parts_reference_ids.description: The reference IDs for each part of the longer message, separated by commas.

updated_on.description: A timestamp showing when your transaction status was updated last.

external_id.description: A customer-generated ID for this transaction that was included in the request.

phone_number_modified.description: Indicates whether Telesign modified the recipient phone number to help with deliverability. Only included if you have this optional feature enabled. Contact our [Customer Support Team](mailto:support@telesign.com) to request this feature.

reference_id.description: A unique, randomly generated hex value that identifies your web service request.

code.description: A numeric code that indicates the status of your transaction.

description.description: Text describing the status of your transaction.

updated_on.description: A timestamp showing when your transaction status was updated last.

Status.description: Contains properties related to the request status.
Status.title: Status

name.description: The name of this template. Use only lowercase alpha characters and underscores. For WhatsApp, the name must include "telesign_otp" if you want Telesign to generate the OTP for you. For example: "verofinto_telesign_otp_wa_template". To enable this feature and create SMS templates with the OTP auto-generated by Telesign, contact our [Customer Support Team](mailto:support@telesign.com).

TemplateButton.title: TemplateButton
TemplateButton.description: Contains properties defining a button included in this template.

button_text.description: Text to display on this button. This cannot be changed in individual Messaging requests using this template.

content.description: Contains properties defining the new template. The array can contain up to one instance of each object type: `header`, `body`, `footer`, `suggested_action`, and `suggested_reply`. A `body` object must be included. To add the first object, select the `Add` button. To add more objects, scroll past the `suggested_reply` object and select the `Add` button again. If you select a different object without using the `Add` button, it will replace your previous selection with the new one.

type.description: Specifies whether the template requires verification by the channel provider or not.

channel.description: The channel the template is used with. Each template can only be used with one channel.

category.description: The category name specifying this template's use case. Only required for WhatsApp templates. Do not include any whitespace characters.

language.description: An abbreviation specifying the language of the text in the template. This is required for WhatsApp templates and not supported for other templates. See  [Messaging - Supported languages for WhatsApp templates](/enterprise/docs/messaging-supported-languages-for-whatsapp-templates) for a list of valid abbreviations.

status.description: The place of this template in Telesign's approval process. Note that WhatsApp templates used to initiate a conversation with a user also must be approved by WhatsApp. Telesign submits these templates for approval on your behalf and passes through the WhatsApp approval status in this same property.

mandatory_parameters.description: Lists each parameter you must include when you use this template in a Telesign Messaging request.

TemplateSection.title: TemplateSection
TemplateSection.description: Contains properties defining a section in a list of options included in this template.

row_number.description: he number of rows included in this section. A maximum of 10 rows can be included across **all** sections in this template.

TemplateSuggestedAction.title: TemplateSuggestedAction
TemplateSuggestedAction.description: Contains properties that define a call-to-action element to include in this template. Supported for WhatsApp templates only. [Variables](/enterprise/docs/messaging-create-whatsapp-template#variables) can be included here.

action_type.description: The type of call-to-action this button provides. A button of type `dial` and one of type `url` can only be included in the same template if it is a WhatsApp template. Button types `url` and `url_dynamic` are only supported for WhatsApp templates.

otp.description: Contains properties defining the parts of the template related to presenting a one-time passcode (OTP) so an end-user can copy it.

otp_text.description: Defines the text shown on a copy code button below a one-time passcode when a WhatsApp copy code authentication template is used. The button allows the end-user to copy a one-time passcode. Use `Autofill` when a WhatsApp one-tap autofill or zero-tap authentication template is used. Required when using the authentication category for WhatsApp verified templates.

package_name.description: Lists your Android app's package name. It must match the package name set on the intent in Android and will have at least two segments (one or more dots), and each segment must start with a letter. All characters must be alphanumeric or an underscore. Required when using a WhatsApp [one-tap autofill](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/whatsapp/business-management-api/authentication-templates/autofill-button-authentication-templates) or [zero-tap](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/whatsapp/business-management-api/authentication-templates/zero-tap-authentication-templates) OTP template.

signature_hash.description: Lists your Android app's signing key hash. It must match the installed app's signing key hash. All characters must be either alphanumeric, +, /, or = (a-zA-Z0-9+/=). Required when using a WhatsApp [one-tap autofill](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/whatsapp/business-management-api/authentication-templates/autofill-button-authentication-templates) or [zero-tap](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/whatsapp/business-management-api/authentication-templates/zero-tap-authentication-templates) OTP template.

zero_tap_terms_accepted.description: Set to `true` to indicate that you understand that your use of [zero-tap](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/whatsapp/business-management-api/authentication-templates/zero-tap-authentication-templates) is subject to the [WhatsApp Business Terms of Service](https://www.whatsapp.com/legal/business-terms), and that it's your responsibility to ensure your end users expect that the code will be automatically filled in on their behalf when they choose to receive the zero-tap code through WhatsApp. If it is set to `false`, the template will **not** be created because you need to accept WhatsApp’s zero-tap terms before creating zero-tap enabled message templates.

dial.description: Contains properties defining a click-to-call button.

phone_number_to_dial.description: The phone number for the end user's device to call when this button is selected. This is required when using click-to-call buttons.

dial_text.description: Text to display on this button. This is required when using click-to-call buttons.

url.description: Contains properties defining a link button.
The complete URL of the destination of this link button. This cannot be modified by individual sends with this template. Required when using link buttons.

url_text.description: Text to display on this button. Required when using link buttons.

url_dynamic.description: Contains properties defining a link button with a URL that can be dynamically modified in each message sent with this template.

url.description: The base URL for the destination of this link button. Can be a static or dynamic url. In each message sent with this template you can add to this path for that send. Note that the maximum length for this value *includes the characters added to the path in any message using this template*. WhatsApp reserves 50 of the 200 characters for its own use. So you should stay far enough below this maximum to leave room for the length of characters you expect each message to add. Required when using link buttons.

url_text.description: Text to display on this button. Required when using link buttons.

code.description: Corresponding status code in case of failure.

description.description: Corresponding status description in case of failure.

header.description: Contains properties related to the header of this template. Not supported for SMS templates. [Variables](/enterprise/docs/messaging-create-whatsapp-template#variables) can be included here.

type.description: The type of content to display in the header of this template. Required when using a template header.

text.description: Text to display in the header of this template. This is required if the value of `type` in this object is `text`. [Variables](/enterprise/docs/messaging-create-whatsapp-template#variables) can be included here.

sample_url.description: The source URL for a sample media file or file for download of the type to be displayed in the messages created with this template. This is required for verified templates if the value of the `type` property in this object is `image`, `video`, or `file`.

sample_text.description: A list of the sample values for each of the variables in `text`. This parameter is required if a variable is used in `text`. Use double curly brackets to include a variable name in a parameter value. See [Variables](/enterprise/docs/messaging-create-whatsapp-template#variables) for more information about formatting variables.

body.description: Contains properties related to the body of this template. [Variables](/enterprise/docs/messaging-create-whatsapp-template#variables) can be included here.

type.description: The type of content to display in the body of this template.

text.description: Text to display in the body of this template. This is required if the value of `type` in this object is `text`. [Variables](/enterprise/docs/messaging-create-whatsapp-template#variables) can be included here.

sample_text.description: A list of the sample values for each of the variables in `text`. This parameter is required if a variable is used in `text`. Use double curly brackets to include a variable name in a parameter value. See [Variables](/enterprise/docs/messaging-create-whatsapp-template#variables) for more information about formatting variables.

footer.description: Contains properties related to the footer of this template. Not supported for SMS templates. Variables are not supported in the footer.

type.description: The type of content to display in the footer of this template. Required when using a template footer.

text.description: Text to display in the footer of this template. This is required if the value of `type` in this object is `text`. Variables are not supported in the footer.

suggested_action.description: Each item contains properties that define a call-to-action element to include in this template. Not supported for SMS templates.

suggested_reply.description: Contains properties that define suggested replies to include in this template. Supported for WhatsApp templates only. [Variables](/enterprise/docs/messaging-create-whatsapp-template#variables) can be included here.

reply_type.description: The type of suggested replies to display in this template. Use `button` for WhatsApp [quick replies](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/messenger-platform/reference/buttons/quick-replies) and `list` for WhatsApp [list messages](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/whatsapp/guides/interactive-messages/#list-messages).

button_number.description: The number of buttons to include in this template. Required for suggested replies with type `buttons`.

buttons.description: Each item contains properties that define a suggested reply button to include in this template. Required when `suggested_reply.reply_type` has the value `button`. See WhatsApp [quick replies](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/messenger-platform/reference/buttons/quick-replies).

sections.description: Each item contains properties that define a suggested reply section to include in this template. Required for suggested replies with type `list`. See WhatsApp [list messages](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/whatsapp/guides/interactive-messages/#list-messages).

channel.name: channel
channel.description: One of the Telesign Messaging channels for which programmatic template management is supported.
